requirements.text: Requests are authorized with VAPID (ES256 JWT, bounded expiry); the private key stays on the server
Subscribe and unsubscribe endpoints require a signed-in user and an allowed origin, and bind the subscription to that user
Subscription endpoints are validated against known push-service hosts and deduplicated
TTL, urgency, topic and payload size are validated before sending
Gone subscriptions (404/410) are deleted and 429 Retry-After is honored
The service worker shows the notification and opens only same-origin URLs
Permission is requested only after a user gesture, and a denied permission is handled

evidence.name: VAPID: key generation, ES256 JWT structure
encrypt -> decrypt round trip with fresh keys
HTTP routes: public key, subscribe, unsubscribe, origin check, auth
subscription validation, endpoint allow-list and dedupe on endpoint
topic, urgency, ttl and payload size are validated before anything is sent
push service statuses: 404/410 delete the subscription
service worker snippet: shows notifications and only opens same-origin URLs

implementations.notes: The page-side permission prompt is documented in CONTRACT.md but not tested
